slides.say: The operation diamond is defined for every integer x. Diamond of x is four x when x is odd, and x squared minus nine when x is even. Diamond of diamond of diamond of one is equal to what?

slides: This rule has conditions. There's one rule for odd numbers and another for even numbers. And there are three diamonds. [short pause] So we'll work from the inside out, and before every step, we check whether the input is odd or even.

slides.say: [short pause] The innermost diamond is diamond of one. One is odd, so we use the odd rule, four x. Four times one is four.
Now four goes into the middle diamond. Careful, four is even, so the rule switches. We use x squared minus nine. Four squared is sixteen, and sixteen minus nine is seven.
Seven goes into the outer diamond. Seven is odd, so we're back to the odd rule. Four times seven is twenty-eight. Choice number three is our answer. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next question.
